outcome: obstetric complications (preterm birth, mode of delivery, LSCS indication)
maternal morbidity (clinical symptoms, oxygen support, comorbidities, need for antibiotics)
neonatal complications (low birth weight, overall neonatal parameters)
cohort: The study included 1442 COVID-19-positive pregnant women.
finding: COVID-19 during pregnancy increased the rates of LSCS, preterm birth, and neonatal complications, with maternal mortality associated with pneumonia and respiratory failure, and vaccination reducing symptom severity.
mod_finding: COVID-19 in pregnancy increased LSCS rates, with 74% of primigravida and 68% of multigravida cases undergoing LSCS.
